validity.reason: All recorded turns use the real provider; every published response is marked as model-origin and has a completed Responses reply call with a response ID. Explicitly expected invalid requests need no model reply. This establishes recorded-provenance eligibility only; failures, unjudged semantics, incomplete coverage, and unverified voice/UI behavior still prevent any product-readiness claim.

scope: Independent text-engine checks of actual generated replies, observed state, scenario assertions, and optional evidence-bound human/model semantic judgments. Missing or invalid semantic reviews remain unjudged. Model judgments are advisory, not ground truth. Voice, audio, browser/UI, microphone capture, and end-to-end voice latency are not tested. No whole-product compliance claim.
